mainEntity.name: Is the end date included in the count?

acceptedAnswer.text: By default no: the count runs from the start date up to, but not including, the end date. Turn on Include the end day to add one. Legal deadlines often specify the rule, so check yours.
Every date in the range that is not a Saturday, Sunday, chosen public holiday or extra day off counts as a working day. A holiday that falls on a weekend is not deducted twice.

The eleven federal holidays: New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Washington's Birthday, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Columbus Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas Day, with weekend observance rules.

mainEntity.name: How does the tool handle leap years?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dates are counted on the real Gregorian calendar, so 29 February is included in leap years. A year is a leap year if divisible by 4, except centuries not divisible by 400.

mainEntity.name: Why is the next working day useful?

acceptedAnswer.text: It shows when work resumes after the interval ends, skipping weekends and holidays. It is handy for delivery windows, notice periods and project handovers.
